messages.text: Create slug.py with slugify(text: str) -> str. Lowercase the text, replace every run of characters that are not a-z or 0-9 with a single hyphen, and strip leading and trailing hyphens. slugify('Hello, World!') == 'hello-world'. slugify('  --A  b--  ') == 'a-b'. slugify('') == ''.

Extend slugify in slug.py: before applying the step 1 rules, decompose the text with unicodedata NFKD and drop every character that has no ASCII form (so accents disappear). slugify('Crème Brûlée') == 'creme-brulee' and slugify('Ærø') == 'r'. Keep step 1 behaviour unchanged.
